translations.web: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ He divided his livelihood between them.
translations.bsb: The younger son said to him, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.
translations.kjv: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
translations.asv: and the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of thy substance that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
